name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 50 – Am 54
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 50b. Calls for the 2027 budget to define the principle of economic, social and territorial cohesion as a horizontal principle, requiring the assessment of the impact on cohesion between and within Member States of all expenditure, policies or actions, with the aim of promoting effective convergence in economic and social progress;
